subject: Next steps: procurement routing and marketplace preference
messages:
From: Helen Brown <helen.brown@stratushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stratushealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up on procurement channel preference

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the latency numbers you showed were really helpful for our architecture review. A few folks on procurement asked me to capture preferred buying routes so we can scope internal approvals. Summary below: 

- Current preference: AWS Marketplace if we can consume via Private Offer (to keep billing central).
- Fallback: Corporate PO payment (Net 30) if marketplace private offer isn’t available or takes too long to set up.
- Card is possible for pilot/dev only, but not for production.
- Timing: procurement estimates ~4–8 weeks depending on vendor paperwork and legal review.

I attached our current procurement checklist as a starting point (procurement_requirements.xlsx). Can you confirm:
1) Whether Redwood supports AWS Private Offers and whether you have an existing process for setting up a PO-based billing alternative?
2) Any internal legal items we should highlight (data residency, audit logs, SOC2 evidence)?
3) If we go marketplace private offer, do you require an MSA or will a standard PO attach to the private offer?

If useful, happy to schedule a 30-min sync between my procurement lead and your billing/legal owner.

Best,
Helen
Helen Brown
Head of Procurement, Stratus Health
helen.brown@stratushealth.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: procurement_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Helen Brown <helen.brown@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on procurement channel preference

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the checklist. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap: you prefer AWS Marketplace Private Offer; fallback is corporate PO (Net 30); card only for pilot/dev. Timing estimate 4–8 weeks.

Answers to your questions:
1) AWS Private Offers: yes, we can do AWS Private Offers for customers. It typically requires a short procurement intake plus a PO that references the private offer. We’ll own creating the private offer on our side and can share the PO instructions for your procurement team.
2) Legal/evidence: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report, IP protection addendum, and an audit-log export process. Neha (cc’d) will share the standard evidence packet and suggested redlines.
3) MSA vs PO: most customers sign our MSA for long-term engagements; however, we can accept a PO tied to the private offer for initial procurement. If you expect to require custom terms, flag them now so legal can triage.

Proposed next steps:
- Neha: share the evidence bundle and a short MSA summary doc (SOW-template.pdf) by EOD tomorrow.
- Helen: confirm who from Stratus procurement would join a 30-min call (we recommend procurement + legal).
- Marcus: draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones (PO submission, legal review, PO approval, account provisioning).

I’ll open a HubSpot record and attach the documents (link below). If that works, I can book a 30-min slot for Wednesday next week — does 10:00–10:30 PT on 2027-06-16 work for your team?

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/7654321

Thanks — talk soon.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
From: Helen Brown <helen.brown@stratushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stratushealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on procurement channel preference

Marcus — thanks, that’s helpful. Confirming the following from procurement:

- We’ll pursue AWS Marketplace Private Offer first. Our billing operations prefers PO referencing a private offer rather than credit card for production.
- Procurement will need the SOC2 and a short MSA summary for legal review. Please send the evidence bundle.
- Attendees for the intake call: me (Helen), Priya K. from procurement (procurement@stratushealth.com), and Daniel S. from IT security (daniel.sullivan@stratushealth.com).
- Timeline: we’ll aim to complete vendor intake in ~2 weeks; legal review may add another 2–4 weeks depending on redlines.

We can do 2027-06-16 10:00–10:30 PT — confirmed. Please send calendar invite and any required pre-read.

Thanks,
Helen

On a side note: procurement asked whether Redwood supports consolidated billing across multiple BU accounts in AWS. Answer to that will help our FinOps team — can you confirm?
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick follow-up on procurement channel preference — planning notes for intake call

Folks — forwarding Helen’s procurement note and their answers. Key asks from procurement: Private Offer + PO billing for production, SOC2 + MSA summary, confirmation on consolidated billing across AWS orgs, and a 30-min intake on 6/16 at 10:00 PT.

Action items I propose:
- Neha: confirm SOC2 + evidence bundle + SOW-template.pdf are ready to send by EOD today. Also draft a 1-page MSA summary we can attach. (owner: Neha)
- Lauren: prepare a one-slide ops checklist for the intake call that covers account provisioning steps for Private Offer vs PO flow (owner: Lauren). Include who on our side will run the private-offer creation and the expected lead time.
- Marcus (me): create the MAP and calendar invite, and include a brief agenda: 1) purchase path decision (private offer vs PO) 2) timeline and dependencies 3) billing/Consolidated billing Q&A 4) next steps.

Related doc: SOW-template.pdf (will attach once Neha confirms). HubSpot deal RW-2027-5893 updated with procurement checklist link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/7654321

I’ll pull together the invite and MAP this afternoon. Anything else we should surface ahead of the call?

—Marcus
